description: Detected transition of a causal loop's regime (e.g. 好循環 → 悪循環 or 悪循環 → 好循環). Raised by junkan_loop_classifier when the dominant stock's trajectory crosses a Council-set threshold. G7 STRUCTURAL: framingNonEschatological const true — described soberly, no fear-amplification / doom / apocalyptic tone (Charter §1.13 + §1.15). G4 STRUCTURAL: actuationTaken const false. A regime shift may RAISE finding severity but never triggers an outward action; downstream consumption (e.g. kazaori read-only) is the consumer's choice, not junkan's act.

detectedAt.description: valid-time at which the shift is judged to have occurred

severity.description: Analytic salience only — NOT an alert that triggers action

framingNonEschatological.description: G7 STRUCTURAL: const true — sober, non-eschatological framing
